title: Steven Lovkin: Eisenhower said he no longer controlled the UFO issue
summary: Steven Greer tells of Steven Lovkin: Eisenhower said he no longer controlled the UFO issue, about 1959-1960 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of our whistleblowers was a young army guy at the White House in the Eisenhower in the signal corps I think 5960 named Steven Lovkin. You can read his testimony in our material and he said that Eisenhower would doodle pictures of these you know ET craft and he was fascinated and he brought the issue up to Eisenhower and said Eisenhower said well I don't have control of this anymore.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who collects testimony from people he calls UFO whistleblowers, told podcast host Jesse Michels about one of them: Steven Lovkin, a young Army man in the signal corps, the unit that handles communications, who worked at the White House around 1959 and 1960. Greer says Lovkin saw President Dwight Eisenhower doodle pictures of alien craft, and that when Lovkin raised the subject, Eisenhower told him, "I don't have control of this anymore." If true, it would mean that even a sitting president had lost his grip on the UFO secret.
